# W2 Zone Maps — Reconciliation Report

*Generated by `build_zone_maps.py`. Inputs: 202,987 shots (1,489 games, seasons 2021–2026) vs `data/masters/master_team.parquet` (2,978 team-games). Data layer only — no model claims (ROADMAP Phase 2c).*

## Zone scheme

Base taxonomy = the API's `SHOT_ZONE_BASIC` (7 zones), collapsed to a 6-zone modeling
scheme by merging the two corners. `SHOT_ZONE_BASIC` agreed with `SHOT_TYPE` on the
2/3-point value for **all 202,987 shots** (0 mismatches), so zone implies points value.

| modeling zone | value | why |
|---|---|---|
| Restricted Area | 2 | as-is |
| In The Paint (Non-RA) | 2 | as-is |
| Mid-Range | 2 | as-is |
| **Corner 3** (merged L+R) | 3 | median player-season attempts 4 (L) / 3 (R); 76% / 87% of cells <10 attempts; league conversion L 36.6% vs R 37.4% (z = −0.79, sign flips across seasons) — no evidence of a real L/R split at these samples |
| Above the Break 3 | 3 | as-is |
| Backcourt | 3 | kept separate: 431 attempts / 5 makes all-time (1.2%); merging into AB3 would bias that zone downward. Always prior-dominated at player level |

`shots_enriched.parquet` keeps the original 7-zone `SHOT_ZONE_BASIC` alongside `zone`,
so nothing is lost by the merge.

## (b) Field-goal points identity (3×3PM + 2×2PM vs pts − ftm)

- Shot-chart FG points == master `pts − ftm`: **2977/2978 (99.97%)** of team-games; total |diff| = 2 points (entirely explained by the dropped rows above).
- The shot chart excludes free throws by design; `pts − ftm` is the exact FG-points truth.

## (c) Paint points vs misc `points_paint`

- Paint flag = `SHOT_ZONE_BASIC ∈ {Restricted Area, In The Paint (Non-RA)}`.
- 2 × paint makes == master `points_paint`: **2978/2978 (100.00%)** of team-games (total |diff| = 0).
- Exact 100% reconciliation ⇒ the misc `pointsPaint` stat is precisely "made FGs in the two paint
  zones × 2" — the flag is drop-in consistent with the paint channel, and none of the four dropped
  shot rows were paint makes.

## Empirical-Bayes shrinkage design (player maps)

**Model.** Beta-binomial. For a cell with `n` attempts, `x` makes and prior mean `p0`,
the posterior mean is `(x + K·p0) / (n + K)` — `K` is the effective prior strength in
pseudo-attempts. Two-stage, position-free (no position data in this layer):

1. team-season zone rate shrunk toward the season league zone rate (strength `K_team`);
2. player-season zone rate shrunk toward that team posterior (strength `K_player`);
   traded players get an attempt-weighted blend of their teams' posteriors.

**K estimation (method of moments, DerSimonian–Laird form).** Per zone, over cells i:
`μ = Σx/Σn`; `Q = Σ nᵢ(rᵢ−μ)² / (μ(1−μ))`; `c = Σn − Σn²/Σn`;
`σ²_between = μ(1−μ)·max(Q−(G−1),0)/c`; `K = μ(1−μ)/σ²_between − 1`, clipped to
[1, 5000]. Player cells = player-season (types pooled, all seasons pooled);
team cells = team-season-type. K is chosen by the data: zones where players genuinely
differ (large between-cell variance) get small K; zones where observed spread is mostly
binomial noise get large K. Estimated values:

| level | metric | zone | μ | σ²_between | K (pseudo-attempts) | cells |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| player | conversion | Restricted Area | 0.6259 | 0.003203 | 72 | 986 |
| player | conversion | In The Paint (Non-RA) | 0.4032 | 0.002309 | 103 | 984 |
| player | conversion | Mid-Range | 0.3725 | 0.001832 | 127 | 958 |
| player | conversion | Corner 3 | 0.3691 | 0.000891 | 260 | 792 |
| player | conversion | Above the Break 3 | 0.3405 | 0.000851 | 263 | 947 |
| player | conversion | Backcourt | 0.0116 | 0.000365 | 30 | 273 |
| team_off | conversion | Restricted Area | 0.6259 | 0.000927 | 252 | 116 |
| team_off | conversion | In The Paint (Non-RA) | 0.4032 | 0.001059 | 226 | 116 |
| team_off | conversion | Mid-Range | 0.3725 | 0.000725 | 321 | 116 |
| team_off | conversion | Corner 3 | 0.3691 | 0.000355 | 655 | 116 |
| team_off | conversion | Above the Break 3 | 0.3405 | 0.000149 | 1509 | 116 |
| team_off | conversion | Backcourt | 0.0116 | 0.001976 | 5 | 98 |
| team_off | share | Restricted Area | 0.2852 | 0.002682 | 75 | 116 |
| team_off | share | In The Paint (Non-RA) | 0.2124 | 0.001415 | 117 | 116 |
| team_off | share | Mid-Range | 0.1649 | 0.002186 | 62 | 116 |

| team_def | conversion | Mid-Range | 0.3725 | 0.000129 | 1807 | 116 |

**Activation.** A player cell is `prior_dominated` when the posterior weight on the player's
own data `n/(n+K)` is below 0.5 (i.e. n < K) **or** n < 10 attempts —
flagged in the CSV, never silently. Zero-attempt cells are emitted explicitly (full 6-zone grid
per player-season) with the prior as the estimate and `prior_dominated=True`.

**Sample sizes and prior-dominated share** (player-season-zone cells):

| zone | observed cells | median FGA | p25 | p75 | prior-dominated (obs cells) | prior-dominated (full grid) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Restricted Area | 986 | 40 | 15 | 81 | 70.7% | 71.8% |
| In The Paint (Non-RA) | 984 | 28 | 11 | 61 | 89.7% | 90.2% |
| Mid-Range | 958 | 20 | 7 | 44 | 95.2% | 95.5% |
| Corner 3 | 792 | 7 | 3 | 15 | 100.0% | 100.0% |
| Above the Break 3 | 947 | 41 | 12 | 92 | 98.1% | 98.2% |
| Backcourt | 273 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 100.0% | 100.0% |

Overall: **90.8%** of observed cells and **92.6%** of the full grid are prior-dominated.

This is deliberately conservative — a WNBA season is ~40 games, so few player-zone cells
out-attempt the noise. The continuous `data_weight` column lets the experiment pick its own
cut without rebuilding. Context (observed cells): 65.8% have ≥10 attempts, 45.7% ≥25, 27.9% ≥50, 9.2% ≥K (the flag).

## Walk-forward spot test (`matchup_overlay.maps_before`)

- Cutoff 2025-08-07 (season 2025): 3 games / 413 shots exist ON the cutoff date; maps built from 25,675 shots / 190 games, all strictly earlier.
- Spot team 1611661329 (played on the cutoff day): map FGA 1945 == its strictly-before shot count; the cutoff-day game is excluded.
- **Result: PASS** — same-day games never enter `maps_before` maps.

## Data surprises & notes

- The league-wide shotchart pull drops 3 rows and adds 1 across 202,987 shots / 1,489 games
  (table above) — worst per-game effect is one shot; nothing systematic by season or team.
- `is_home` (master) vs shot-chart `HTM`: 0 disagreements across all shots.
- Master vs shot-chart game dates: 0 mismatches.
- Expansion teams appear cleanly: GSV from 2025; TOR and **PDX** (Portland Fire — not "POR")
  from 2026 (12/12/12/12/13/15 offense units by season). Their thin early-season history is a
  `maps_before` caveat (explicit KeyError before their first game), not a data gap.
- **Phoenix's abbreviation changed PHO → PHX in 2025** (same team_id 1611661317). Query maps by
  `team_id` across seasons; abbreviations are season-scoped display strings.
- Backcourt heaves are real attempts that FGA reconciliation must keep — they are their own
  zone precisely so they cannot pollute Above-the-Break-3 conversion.

## Files

| file | grain | rows |
|---|---|---|
| `shots_enriched.parquet` | shot | 202,987 |
| `team_zone_offense.csv` | season × type × team × zone | 696 |
| `team_zone_defense.csv` | season × type × team × zone (allowed) | 696 |
| `player_zone_offense.csv` | season × player × zone (full 6-zone grid) | 6,156 |
| `league_zone_averages.csv` | season × type × zone | 66 |
| `shrinkage_priors.csv` | level × metric × zone | 30 |

Team/player conversion columns come in raw and `_shrunk` forms; `maps_before` recomputes
all *rates* from the pre-cutoff slice only. The stored K constants are full-sample
variance-ratio hyperparameters — a strict walk-forward experiment may re-estimate them on
train years and pass `k_table=` (documented in `matchup_overlay.py`).
